# Toy Auto Center

> Family-owned independent auto repair shop and NYS Certified Motor Vehicle Inspection Station in Blauvelt, New York (Rockland County), open since 1976. Toyota and Lexus specialists; all makes and models, domestic and import.

## Contact
- Address: 628 Route 303 (NY-303), Blauvelt, NY 10913. 1 block off 303 on Birchwood Drive.
- Shop phone: 845.365.3003
- Cell / text: 201.394.8673
- Email: info@toyautocenter.net
- Hours: Monday to Friday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Saturday by appointment. Sunday closed.
- [Book an appointment](https://toyautocenter.net/contact/)

## Service area
Blauvelt, Orangeburg, Tappan, Nyack, West Nyack, Nanuet, Pearl River, Piermont, Sparkill, Congers, Valley Cottage, New City (Rockland County, NY), and Northvale and Norwood (Bergen County, NJ). See the [service area](https://toyautocenter.net/service-area/).
